text: With a running key, the key is a book's text. Where the message is known, working backwards gives 24 letters of that book, which would read as English. Tried with tables built from every dictionary word, three ways, three rules, two key alphabets.
The best of 3.7 million readings scores -4.94 on K4; the same search on 50 scrambled coppers gives -5.28 to -4.30. Twenty hidden running keys from Carter's book score -4.78 to -3.82.
K4 sits in the middle of the coppers and below every hidden running key: a running key from an English text on such a table would have shown. Closed as sampled at stated power.
